note: Re-judged 2026-11-19 after 3977cef525 (AC-21). RFC 4301 Section 4.1: "The receiver MUST process the packets from the different SAs without prejudice.  These requirements apply to both transport and tunnel mode SAs." The stale unit TestRFC4301BoundarySADEntryCarriesWhatTheKernelLooksUp now builds its two SAs with boundaryInboundSA (Dir SADirIn, ReplayWin 64) because xfrmStateFromParams refuses a window on an outbound state; its assertions (two distinct SAD entries, each its own SPI, same selector) are unchanged. TestRFC4301ParallelSAsWithOneSelectorAreEachReceived and TestRFC4301ParallelSAsAreHeldToTheOneSharedPolicy are unchanged since the last judgement: two tunnel Child SAs with one selector, first/second/first all delivered; an outside-source packet on each SA is refused at the SA selector (XfrmInStateMismatch +1 per SA, both SPD counters unchanged). parallelChildPair still never builds two transport-mode SAs, so the transport half of the sentence is not exercised. Verdict stays weak; a transport counterpart is owed.
